subtasks: Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.
Reopen the egg holder and reseat the high rear-right egg fully down in its cup while keeping all four eggs inside.
Reseat the elevated front-left egg fully down in its cup, keeping the lid open and the other three eggs in place.
Gently close the open egg holder lid over the four eggs, then fully open both grippers and return both arms to their starting poses.
